zone:lake nerius: Wiki quest starts and castle approach: Retainer Ozval begins Hate, Betrayal, and Trust. The blessing supports normal zones and solo/multiplayer non-raid personal instances as of October 27; raid instances remain excluded. The final blessing hand-in requires level 46 in the current wiki walkthrough. https://eqlwiki.com/Hate%2C_Betrayal%2C_and_Trust?oldid=200308
zone:nektropos castle: Wiki access and routes: Hate, Betrayal, and Trust begins with Retainer Ozval in Lake Nerius; the library-key combine in The Tragic Tale of House Everling; then The Betrayer for door keys and the basement. Unknown NPC coordinates remain unknown. https://eqlwiki.com/Nektropos_Castle?oldid=200257

November 4: Hailing Ollix to restart the quest now preserves earned tower access. Previously lost access is not restored retroactively. https://www.everquestlegends.com/patch-notes/eql-hotfix-notes-11-4-2026

November 4: Undead see normal invisibility; living NPCs see invisibility versus undead. Some rare/named creatures detect all invisibility. Shroud of Stealth is generally effective. https://www.everquestlegends.com/patch-notes/eql-hotfix-notes-11-4-2026

October 29: required quest items can be found in Equipment Storage; Alexa encounter debuffs end on her death. Respawn reductions were published without exact timers. https://www.everquestlegends.com/patch-notes/eql-update-notes-10-29-2026
zone:nektropos undercroft: Wiki access: tunnel entrance (1620, -930, 0); cellar door (2435, -1155, -10) along the castle's south wall in Lake Nerius. https://eqlwiki.com/The_Nektropos_Undercroft?oldid=199480
